Run it on X from Friday, October 22, 2027 through Sunday, October 31, 2027, inclusive: all 10 days in our account's UK time zone. The objective is as many free-trial starts as possible. We count completed free-trial starts, so keep that outcome central.

Send visitors to https://kettlefern.app/lantern-evenings. Here's the copy from our landing page: "Kettlefern is a London-based streaming app for slice-of-life and iyashikei anime, with a Lantern Evenings collection of gentle small-town stories for Halloween. Start a 7-day free trial, then £4.99 a month; cancel anytime. Available in the United Kingdom and Ireland to new subscribers aged 18 or over."

Our site does not have X's pixel, so X cannot see the trial starts. You have permission to launch and manage the campaign yourself without asking me for approval. Watch it throughout the flight and make the necessary adjustments; I expect active management through the final day. At the end, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks.

Total budget: 500.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 4 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:

Recap for Oct 22-31 UK

Halloween flight complete — ran Oct 22-31 inclusive, UK time, and now paused.

What I ran:
- One campaign, one ad group, capped at $500 total ($50/day).
- Objective: Website Clicks optimized for Link Clicks as the proxy for free-trial starts, since your site has no X pixel so X cannot see completed trials.
- Geo: United Kingdom + Ireland only. Audience expansion off so we stayed in-market.
- Creatives (only your approved posts): promoted 2243139890184686641 and 2243683471980145632 — the two with the trial offer and price. I held back the two vague posts to avoid unqualified clicks. Monitored Oct 24, 27, 30 and Nov 1; the clearer post drove ~78% of clicks but CPCs were similar, so I kept both live for qualified volume.

Recap for Oct 22-31 UK:
- Spend: $472.62
- Impressions: 446,740
- Link clicks: 158

Under your $500 budget. X cannot report completed free-trial starts without the pixel — use your kettlefern.app/lantern-evenings trial signups for Oct 22-31 in the UK/IE to close the loop.
